description: This file defines a composable UI component for displaying a news resource card in an Android app, including header image, title, bookmark button, metadata, description, and topics.

methods.name: NewsResourceCardExpanded
methods.description: Main composable function to display an expanded news resource card with image, title, bookmark, metadata, description, and topics.

methods.name: NewsResourceHeaderImage
methods.description: Displays the header image with loading indicator and placeholder fallback.

methods.name: NewsResourceTitle
methods.description: Displays the title of the news resource.

methods.name: BookmarkButton
methods.description: Toggle button for bookmarking the news resource.

methods.name: NotificationDot
methods.description: Small dot indicator for unread status.

methods.name: dateFormatted
methods.description: Formats the publish date into a localized string.

methods.name: NewsResourceMetaData
methods.description: Displays formatted publish date and resource type.

methods.name: NewsResourceShortDescription
methods.description: Displays a short description of the news resource.

methods.name: NewsResourceTopics
methods.description: Displays a scrollable list of topic tags.
